name: Enrich Discogen Research
runs_on: Table Companies (implied), a View by name on the launch row
reads: Domain on every row of the view; the value already held in Output Field (skipped unless Overwrite)
creates: the column named by Output Field, at the Airtable type Output Type declares (Long text, Text, Number, Checkbox, Single select); with Evidence on, also '<Output Field> Evidence' (long text) and '<Output Field> Confidence' (number). Created on first use; a column that exists at another type is refused as someone else's
held_value: fill blanks only; Overwrite on asks every row in the view again and rewrites it; an 'unknown' answer under Evidence is written blank so a rerun picks it up
providers: DiscoLike DiscoGen (POST /v1/discogen/process, context_mode website, web_search per the row, the account's default LLM and search provider); one submit per 10,000 domains, polled until completed, up to 8 hours; no credential or a dead API is a logged skip
logs: the launch row only: rows in view, skipped (no domain, already answered), submitted, answered, unknown, unparsed, missing, written, refused; task ids; DiscoLike's estimated cost
refusals: no Client, no valid base, Table not Companies, no View, no Prompt, no Output Field, Output Type not one of the five, Max companies empty, more rows to ask than Max companies, Output Field held by another type
